<!-- SYNTHETIC FIXTURE: written for Blockbase tests, not copied from 21st.dev -->
You are given a task to integrate an existing React component in the codebase

The codebase should support:
- shadcn project structure
- Tailwind CSS
- Typescript

Copy-paste this component to /components/ui folder:
```tsx
skyline-card.tsx
"use client"
import * as React from "react"
import { gsap } from "gsap"
import { ScrollTrigger } from "gsap/ScrollTrigger"

gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger);

export function SkylineCard({ title }: { title: string }) {
  const label = `Card ${title} keeps a \` backtick`;
  return <div className="skyline-card">{label}</div>;
}

export default SkylineCard;

demo.tsx
import { SkylineCard } from "@/components/ui/skyline-card"

export default function Demo() {
  return <SkylineCard title="Demo" />;
}
```

Install NPM dependencies:
```bash
gsap@3.12.5
```
